reusable_lessons: A passed total is not a source audit; compare material/type identities, all printed bins, and supplemental rows independently.
Leading structural dots and omitted leading cells create positive AND negative candidate offsets; exact source geometry must admit both.
Repeated sparse digits cannot justify arithmetic-fit origins. Preserve missing cells and ambiguity until independent printed evidence exists.
Wrapped Hospital) is a Charitable label continuation, not a Hospital row; canonical category matching and printed baselines must precede facing joins.
Numeric row labels are not automatically totals. FT OtherStone label1 conflicts with printedTotal2; printed total-column evidence is mandatory.
Large candidate y errors can be recovered only by a unique rich distinct-digit vector; sparse rows instead need the same independently printed identity.

A row omitted by publication is different from a missing extraction half. Source-backed facing dot marks can complete a published row; omitted categories need check applicability, not synthesized zero data.
Clean-looking PDF words can be corrupt: appended gridline1, dropped thousands or glyphJ. Visual reads reject such false discrepancy candidates.
Source totals may genuinely disagree: Table12 All/Wood199,653 andTable22 All/Unspecified inmates10=3 must remain explicit, never balanced.

reusable_lessons: Passing nonnegative/legal-currency checks cannot establish source alignment: all93 changed fields escaped current FAIL/INCOMPLETE checks.
Treat facing-page state columns as independent printed grids; a spurious absence mark can silently shift FT and Commonwealth fields while every resulting decimal still looks valid.
Combined s./d. candidates can reverse units over a contiguous source batch. Correct that repeated cause within its known page/row geometry, then retain exceptional source scalars separately.
An unavailable FT block on preceding rows does not imply FT16+ is unavailable. The source can print a real amount while the candidate loses the final total pair instead.
Existing direct PDF override dictionaries are transcription claims, not authoritative evidence: Table63 room9 override itself had an incorrect digit.

For compact currency print, render separate4× horizontal half-panels: full-width2.5× views can confuse small2/3,5/8 and9/0 digits. Rejected provisional readings were corrected before delivery; only final high-resolution-confirmed readings are in evidence.
Keep genuine absent categories explicit: Unspecified exists on59/61 but not60/62/63. Printed absence marks are not zero.
Do not convert an arithmetic mismatch into a digit recovery. Arithmetic prompted higher-resolution inspection, but final changes came from visible source readings.

reusable_lessons: Arithmetic agreement is not source correctness: passing Hawes rental and JervisBay precision were wrong; image-only Gipps/Longford readings must remain even when less arithmetically convenient.
Unique anchors require uniqueness in candidate and source; repeated equal counts can silently collapse distinct field slots.
Only clean numeric PDF evidence may replace candidate values. Invalid OCR/rule fragments cannot replace source no-value marks or unreadable print.
Independent row coverage catches complete missing lines that no per-row arithmetic test can see.
Correction identity must include state/section, not merely physical page plus geography name.
Repeated braced denominators are group metadata, not per-row denominators.
Zoom punctuation, not just digits: printed comma(Tinaroo), scan speck(York), thousands comma(Disraeli) and damaged glyph(Dublin) have different dispositions.
Headers/footnotes define units; summary urban Acres and rural Square miles must not be silently normalized.

findings.title: Tinaroo’s printed comma is preserved, but its numerical interpretation is treated as certain
locations: Original Dwellings PDF, physical p193, Table 68, Queensland / Shires / Tinaroo, occupied dwellings per square mile; source row p193::r45, y553.09
findings.evidence: The inspected source image unmistakably prints 3,279, with a comma, beside area 272 and occupied dwellings 892. The preserved baseline exports this as numeric 3279. Its density check is correctly FAIL, but its unreadable-field count is zero and the density formula uses integer last-digit tolerance 0.5. The current parser removes comma separators and the current writer emits the result as a number. Recurrence after rebuilding is an unexecuted code prediction, not an observed new-workbook result.
findings.analytical_impact: A consumer using the numerical density column independently of the adjacent checks can import an extreme outlier into summaries or chart scales. Preserving the printed punctuation is correct; it does not establish that 3279 is a substantively interpretable density. The visible FAIL reduces the risk but does not distinguish a historical source inconsistency from an extraction error. This is not evidence authorising replacement with 3.279.
findings.proposed_check: Parent should inspect the rebuilt typed cell and its provenance/check together. Preserve the literal 3,279 and explicitly identify the numerical interpretation as unresolved/source-conflicted, preferably through field-specific text handling. Do not infer a replacement from 892/272, broaden the tolerance, or change general comma parsing for ordinary count fields. Verify that the displayed reading survives and is not represented as either a validated 3279 or an imputed 3.279.

ReviewAuditCheckDefinitions.conclusion: No confirmed analytical error was found in the requested new source-scope corrections. The inspected source evidence supports the bounded identities and exclusions below. This does not validate every whitelist entry, every digit, or the rebuilt workbook; the output inspected here remains the preserved pre-audit baseline.

research_scope.question: Does the workbook enforce only arithmetic identities established by the 1911 source, without equating unlike populations or converting missing extraction into zero?
research_scope.intended_output: A source-faithful review workbook of the 68 contents-indexed Dwellings tables, with numerical readings where unambiguous and visible diagnostic formulas.
research_scope.estimands_and_units: Published census counts and descriptive means at 3 April 1911, not causal effects. Rows identify geography and dwelling class/category; fixed-room comparisons identify geography and an exact room count. Currency amounts are shillings/pence, converted to pence for comparison. Relevant dwelling captions exclude dwellings occupied solely by Full-blooded Aboriginals; Table 67 excludes all details relating to that population, using the historical source wording.
research_scope.trace: Saved PDF-derived images and source-region records → candidate/mapping reading strings → assembled table rows → count/measure check builders → Excel numeric conversion, formulas and cached results. Current code was inspected statically; saved baseline output was inspected separately.

source_scope_review.subject: T2/T67 inmates-per-dwelling divided by rooms-per-dwelling
source_scope_review.disposition: Do not enforce without matched cohorts.
source_scope_review.source: Physical p5, Table 2 measure headings; p6, Table 3 dwelling total followed by separately printed camps without dwellings; p178, Table 67 caption/headings.
source_scope_review.evidence: The source distinguishes dwelling counts/inmates from population and separately lists camps without dwellings. The inspected summary headings do not establish a common complete-case denominator for all three rounded means. There is therefore no source-backed basis for requiring their quotient to match.
source_scope_review.implementation_assessment: The quotient is explicitly N/A rather than passed through a larger tolerance. The persons/occupied comparison is also excluded for T2/T67. This is a conservative source-scope decision, not evidence that every individual row necessarily uses different cohorts.

source_scope_review.subject: Finite T59→60 and T61→62 comparisons
source_scope_review.disposition: Supported for exact room counts 1–15 and matching geography.
source_scope_review.source: Physical pp126–127, Tables 59/60/61 captions and room grids; pp128–129, Table 62 caption and grid. The facing caption on p127 completes the room-classification and Aboriginal-exclusion wording.
source_scope_review.evidence: Tables 59/60 describe inmates per occupied private dwelling versus per room; Tables 61/62 describe weekly rental per occupied private dwelling versus per room. Their exact-room rows permit division by the fixed room count. For example, p126 prints NSW whole-state three-room values 3.635 and 1.212; p126/p128 print Sydney two-room rent 7s.1d. and 3s.6d. These are independently observed source readings, not runtime check outcomes.
source_scope_review.implementation_assessment: Only 1–15 are enforced. Open-ended, unspecified and aggregate rows are N/A. A unique source counterpart is required; absent or duplicate counterparts are INCOMPLETE. Both printed rounding intervals are propagated as source_half_digit/rooms + target_half_digit. Currency is converted using 12s+d and its rounding allowance comes from pence precision, not an additional half-shilling allowance. Fully marked pairs are N/A; nonnumeric or half-present numeric pairs remain incomplete.

source_scope_review.subject: T8/T9 population reconciliation and supplements
source_scope_review.disposition: All-dwelling inmate subtotal + camps without dwellings + shipping = total population; supplements are not private-plus-other dwelling categories.
source_scope_review.source: Physical p14, Table 8 final All panel and supplements; p15, Table 9 final All panel and supplements.
source_scope_review.evidence: Both source panels print Commonwealth dwelling inmates 4,416,360, camps without dwellings 11,409, shipping 27,236 and total population 4,455,005. The supplements occur after the dwelling subtotal.
source_scope_review.implementation_assessment: Dwelling section sums exclude camps, shipping and total population. The population identity requires one occurrence of each of its four rows. Missing or duplicate components become INCOMPLETE. Private-plus-other checks skip all three supplement categories.

source_scope_review.subject: T57/T58 absence of shipping and total-population rows
source_scope_review.disposition: Do not manufacture a metropolitan population identity.
source_scope_review.source: Physical p125, Table 57 All-panel ending, and Table 58 final All-panel ending; images p125_g3 and p125_g8.
source_scope_review.evidence: The inspected endings print the dwelling-inmate total 1,693,940 and a separate camps-without-dwellings row 389, but no shipping-population or total-population row.
source_scope_review.implementation_assessment: The population-check loop creates a check only when a total-population target exists. Thus the source-faithful T57/T58 bodies should create none. Supplements are also excluded from private-plus-other comparisons. Parent should verify the rebuilt mapper output contains no invented shipping/total-population rows.

source_scope_review.subject: Finite class omissions versus missing extraction
source_scope_review.disposition: Supported for the inspected representative omissions; not a general missing-as-zero rule.
source_scope_review.source: Physical p117, Table 54 Other panel; p125, Table 58 Other panel; p69, Table 37 private/other room rows; p70, Table 38 private/other room rows.
source_scope_review.evidence: T54/T58 Other panels omit the six listed materials: Sun-dried Bricks, Pisé, Wattle and Dab, Bark, Bushes/Rushes/Spinifex, and Calico/Canvas/Hessian. T37’s private continuation has rooms 1–10 then Unspecified, while its Other panel skips room 7. T38’s private continuation skips room 13, which is present in Other; its Other panel also omits rooms such as 3 and 4. These are visible source-panel omissions, not absent OCR candidates alone.
source_scope_review.implementation_assessment: Exceptions are keyed by table, class and normalised category. They relax the requirement for a missing partner row only when comparing an existing All row with its published partner. They do not generate data rows or zero-valued cells. A present blank/unreadable partner still fails the numeric guard, and duplicate partners remain incomplete. Both partners missing cannot silently pass because delta requires components.

source_scope_review.subject: Table 11 national scope and exporter integration
source_scope_review.disposition: No within-tab Commonwealth check is source-supported.
source_scope_review.source: Physical pp16–21, Table 11; p20 explicitly labels the final section VIII—Federal Territory, whose continuation ends on p21 before Table 12 begins on p22. The Commonwealth table preceding it is Table 10, not an additional Table 11 panel.
source_scope_review.implementation_assessment: The inspected current count builder contains no special Table 11 national aggregation. Export input is sorted by table number, so T59/T61 are assembled before the new T60/T62 cross-sheet checks. Those checks reference the original data cells with the same header/row offsets used by the writer. Formula/cache pairs are written together to XLSX and CSV. The added T59–63 Aboriginal-exclusion caption agrees with the inspected source. These are static integration observations, not a post-rebuild or Excel-recalculation verification.

proposed_parent_checks.check: Exercise the finite-room and penny-precision scenarios after integration, including one mismatch outside the permitted rounding interval, a missing numeric unit, a duplicate source counterpart, and an open-ended room bin.
proposed_parent_checks.purpose: Demonstrate that the new comparisons distinguish genuine mismatch, incomplete evidence and non-applicability; compare actual workbook formula results with build-time caches.

proposed_parent_checks.check: Exercise T8/T9 with a missing or duplicate shipping/camp component, and inspect T57/T58 rebuilt row identities.
proposed_parent_checks.purpose: Demonstrate that missing evidence does not become zero and that metropolitan population rows are not invented.

proposed_parent_checks.check: For a reviewed omitted class, change an All value and observe the resulting nonzero delta; separately remove an ordinary non-whitelisted partner and blank a present required cell.
proposed_parent_checks.purpose: Demonstrate that the finite omission allowance cannot mask mismatches or arbitrary data loss.

proposed_parent_checks.check: Inspect the final Table 11 sheet for only source-supported section/row checks and no within-tab Commonwealth aggregation.
proposed_parent_checks.purpose: Confirm the removed national check has not returned through exporter integration.

reusable_lessons: A ratio of rounded averages is an identity only after establishing common denominators and cohorts; arithmetic agreement cannot establish that scope.
An exact finite room bin supplies a legitimate divisor. An open-ended bin or aggregate does not.
Propagate half-last-digit intervals for both printed measures. Shillings and pence are components of one amount, not independently rounded monetary estimates.
A reviewed omitted class row is different from a present unreadable cell or an absent extraction candidate. Exceptions must remain finite and provenance-backed.
Literal source preservation and numerical interpretation are separate decisions. An internally inconsistent printed value must not be reconstructed from arithmetic.
Changing check universes changes PASS/FAIL/N/A populations. Their aggregate changes are not digit-accuracy or correction counts.
material_uninspected_areas: No complete independent reinspection of all _PUBLISHED_ABSENCES entries, particularly the additional state-material entries in Tables 12–29 and Tables 33–36. The representative T54/T58 and sparse T37/T38 entries were inspected.
No complete cell-by-cell digit audit of all 68 sheets or all completed family correction records.
Other room/rent mappers still being edited were not audited as final implementations.
No rebuilt workbook, current formula caches, desktop-Excel recalculation or end-to-end source-to-output run was observed.

evidence_and_limits.method: Read-only inspection of current Python source, documentation, saved PDF-derived images/source-region metadata, and preserved baseline JSON/XLSX/CSV. No edits, writes, delegation, code execution, builds, tests, linters, formatters, paid calls or production operations.
evidence_and_limits.source_provenance: The saved render catalogue and baseline manifest both record source SHA-256 d2a7f6b00a4c9e31c09011e69b09315e47a59f0dadbf6dd275d05fc897cb5db6. This hash was read, not independently recomputed. Render records retain the older spaced source filename. All page references above are physical PDF pages.

evidence_and_limits.runtime_verification: None performed under this read-only assignment. All proposed checks are for the parent and remain unexecuted.

lessons: Inventory printed rows, units, sections and physical columns before model mapping. Do not treat model proposals as the row universe.
Bind values to physical row and panel before joining facing pages; leader dots and page-local column offsets are not data.
A total anchor is insufficient where totals repeat or OCR drops a glyph. Preserve a matching lower bound only with independent figure-grid corroboration.
Join split numeral tokens before reading lower bounds; retain separate pounds/shillings units.
Separate explicit printed absence, genuinely empty source, missing extraction, obscured digits and publication conflicts; do not fill them all with zero.
Use finite source-backed omission records. Never infer a missing digit from a residual.
Apply identities only to matching cohorts/units and printed precision; open-ended bins and unsupported average relationships are not exact identities.
Check first/interior/last, sparse and multiline rows as well as totals. Legal currency and passing totals do not prove digits.
Tests must use full real section/state contexts and select the intended class. Retire wording/incidental fixture assertions.
Exercise actual Excel recalculation and live edits. Cached agreement alone missed implicit-intersection narrowing of MOD(range,1).
Existing manual overrides can be wrong; use bounded independent image reads, record revised claims, and do not claim a full independent digit census.
For another document, reuse this protocol but establish its own printed layouts, cohorts and precision; prove a source-checked pilot before bulk work.
